title: Three-Headed Wanderer
description: A surreal black and white line drawing depicts a tall three-headed humanoid figure with a single central eye on the top head, holding a circular compass-like object with a red arrow. In the foreground, a backpacked hiker with a walking stick traverses a path through a purple lavender field, with mountains, small figures, red geometric shapes, and abstract symbols in the background.
prompt: surreal ink drawing of a tall three-headed humanoid with one central eye on the top head, holding a circular compass with red arrow, standing behind a backpacked hiker with walking stick walking through purple lavender fields, distant mountains with tiny figures, floating red triangles and abstract symbols in the sky, black line art with selective purple and red watercolor washes, mystical and symbolic atmosphere
